title: From Visual Affinity to Learning Credit in Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32324v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves multimodal reasoning, but uniformly assigning a single response-level advantage to all tokens overlooks the distinct roles of visual observations and subsequent reasoning. Visual affinity alone is insufficient: predictive states may align with both image and prompt-context representations, and upweighting valid visual observations can amplify their negative-advantage updates when later reasoning fails. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{Outcome-Conditioned Visual Credit (OVC)}, a plug-in framework that separates visual-association measurement from token-level credit assignment and is adaptable to policy-optimization methods with uniform response-level advantage allocation. Relative Visual Encoding constructs a context-relative visual coordinate by contrasting each predictive state's affinity to image and prompt-context representations. Outcome-conditioned Evidence Cali

translated_title: 多模态强化学习中从视觉亲和度到学习信用
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够提升多模态推理能力，但将单一的响应级优势均匀分配给所有标记（token）的做法，忽视了视觉观测与后续推理所扮演的不同角色。仅凭视觉亲和度是不够的：预测状态可能同时与图像表示和提示上下文表示对齐，而当后续推理失败时，对有效视觉观测进行加权反而会放大其负优势更新。为解决这一问题，我们提出了结果条件化视觉信用分配，这是一种即插即用框架，将视觉关联度量与标记级信用分配分离开来，并且能够适配于采用均匀响应级优势分配的策略优化方法。相对视觉编码通过对比每个预测状态与图像和提示上下文表示的亲和度，构建了一个上下文相对的视觉坐标系。结果条件化的证据校准（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出结果条件化视觉信用分配框架，通过将视觉关联度量与标记级信用分配分离，解决了多模态强化学习中均匀优势分配忽视视觉观测独特作用的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Outcome-Conditioned Visual Credit (OVC), a plug-in framework that separates visual-association measurement from token-level credit assignment, addressing the overlooked distinct roles of visual observations in multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.
